help.title: Background Clicker
help.intro: How to automate clicks without giving up your mouse.

quickStart.heading: Quick start
quickStart.step1: Press Start setup, hover the point you want in the target window, and press F10 to capture it.
quickStart.step2: Type a name in the Profile box and press Save.
quickStart.step3: Press START for a single test click, or turn on Auto-repeat for continuous clicking.

profiles.heading: Profiles & sequences
profiles.body: A profile stores everything: the target window, the coordinates, the timings and every toggle. A sequence is a list of clicks that runs in order.
profiles.item1: Save, load and delete profiles from the Profile row at the top.
profiles.item2: Switch the target to Sequence, press Capture point, and press F10 at each spot. Turn on Record steps first to capture several in one pass.
profiles.item3: Double-click any step in the list to change its delay or double-click setting.

modes.heading: Click modes
modes.nonBlockingBody: Sends the click straight to the window by its title. Your cursor never moves and your work is never interrupted. This is the recommended mode.
modes.blockingBody: For apps that ignore background messages, such as some games. This briefly moves your real cursor to perform the click, so you lose the mouse for a moment.

features.heading: Other features
features.item1: Press F8 anywhere to start or stop the clicker, even while this window is minimized.
features.item2: Randomize interval and Click jitter make the timing and position look less mechanical.
features.item3: Keep on top pins this window above the target, and the sound toggles confirm clicks and errors by ear.
features.item4: Stop after a number of clicks or a number of minutes to bound an unattended run.

credits.title: Background Clicker
credits.feature1Body: Sends clicks to a window without moving your mouse or stealing focus.
credits.feature2Body: Chains clicks with individual delays for multi-step routines.
credits.feature3Body: Saves and reloads a full configuration per task.
credits.feature4Body: Click jitter and randomized intervals make timing look less mechanical.
credits.feature5Body: Falls back to a blocking click for apps that ignore background events.
credits.feature6Body: Starts and stops from anywhere with F8.
credits.module1Body: Set the interval, pick the mouse button, single or double.
credits.module2Body: Click at the cursor, or at a fixed screen position.
credits.module3Body: F9 starts and stops, F10 picks the current position.
credits.techBody: Built with WPF and C#. It uses the Win32 messaging API to post mouse events directly to a window handle, which is what lets it click without taking control of your cursor.
credits.translationBody: Languages are built into the executable. To add your own, create a Lang folder next to the program, copy en.json into it, translate the values and change the _meta block.
